goal: Migrate https://www.sialparis.com/fr-FR to a Jahia JS module (project: sial-paris, namespace sialp, siteKey sial-paris, primary language fr). Each step is proven by its PROBE command; a step is done only when the probe exits 0.

epics.title: Foundation: connect + analyze
epics.goal: Confirm the Jahia server is reachable and produce a complete component/content manifest for the reference site.

review_criteria: Jahia server reachable and credentials valid
component-manifest.json and content-data.json exist with total instances > 0
Component scope was presented to the operator (Gate 1)

stories.title: Analyze the reference site
stories.description: Verify server connectivity, then download and analyze https://www.sialparis.com/fr-FR into a component manifest and content data set.
acceptance_criteria: Operator has seen the component scope

steps.title: Analyze reference site -> manifest (Gate 1: HALT for scope review)
acceptance_criteria: Gate 1: present the numbered section map and proposed CND field splits, then return status halt for operator sign-off.

epics.title: Scaffold module + import assets
epics.goal: Scaffold the Jahia JS module (namespace sialp) and import the reference site's CSS/JS/fonts/images into static/.

review_criteria: package.json present and yarn build exits 0
All Layout-referenced stylesheets exist under static/

stories.title: Scaffold the module
stories.description: Create the Jahia JS module with namespace sialp and confirm it builds.

steps.title: Scaffold module (Gate 2: HALT for namespace confirmation)
acceptance_criteria: Gate 2: present the module structure, namespace sialp, and package.json name; return status halt for operator confirmation.

stories.title: Import assets
stories.description: Copy CSS, JS, fonts and images into static/ and reference them from Layout.tsx.

epics.title: Content model: types + navigation + listing
epics.goal: Define CND content types, a 3-level MainNavigation component, and the JCRQuery + GridRow listing components in the sialp namespace.

review_criteria: Every type appears in definitions.cnd with en+fr resource bundle keys (label + ui.tooltip)
Navigation uses a Jahia Navigation Menu component, 3 levels deep, no hardcoded links
Module ships JCRQuery and GridRow components; tags/categories use Jahia built-ins

stories.title: Define content types
stories.description: Create CND definitions + types.ts for every component in the manifest, with i18n labels and ui.tooltip keys.

stories.title: Implement 3-level navigation
stories.description: Build the sialp MainNavigation component backed by the JCR page tree, 3 levels deep.

steps.title: Implement MainNavigation (3 levels)

inputs.sections: le-salon, temps-forts, tendances, infos-pratiques, exposer (plus existing les-exposants, medias)

acceptance_criteria: Navigation must render 3 levels deep from the JCR page tree (getChildNodes on home for L1, recurse for L2 and L3), matching orchestration/sitemaps/sial-paris.txt. No hardcoded links. L2/L3 render as dropdown/fly-out.

stories.title: Implement JCRQuery + GridRow
stories.description: Build the sialp JCRQuery listing component and the GridRow layout component.

epics.title: Components + page templates + deploy
epics.goal: Implement all section components verbatim to the reference, build the page templates (Layout + AbsoluteAreas), and deploy the module ACTIVE.

review_criteria: Every manifest component has a view with verbatim reference class names and a resource-bundle label
Layout has header + footer AbsoluteArea; page templates exist
Module deploys ACTIVE; shell renders header+footer with no console errors (Gate 3)

stories.title: Implement all components
stories.description: Implement every component from the manifest with verbatim Sitecore SXA class names and i18n labels.

steps.title: Implement all section components
acceptance_criteria: Work from the existing component library (run `bash orchestration/probes/inventory.sh projects/sial-paris sialp`). Add views to existing types where markup varies; only the operator-approved set of types may exist. Do not duplicate a type that already covers a section.

stories.title: Page templates + deploy
stories.description: Build Layout.tsx with header/footer AbsoluteAreas and page template variants, then deploy.

steps.title: Deploy module (Gate 3: HALT for shell layout review)
acceptance_criteria: Gate 3: present a screenshot of the deployed shell (header+footer, empty main, no console errors); return status halt for operator confirmation.

stories.title: Fix look-and-feel discrepancies (home + shared components)
stories.description: Before creating the deep page tree, bring the deployed home page and shared section components to visual parity with the reference. Components are reused across all 30+ pages, so fixing them once propagates everywhere - this is why fidelity comes before breadth.
acceptance_criteria: Home and existing section landings match the reference at 1440px and 375px
Module still builds and home still renders after the fixes

steps.title: Fix component fidelity vs reference (Gate 4-pre: HALT)

inputs.referencePages: home, le-salon, temps-forts, tendances, infos-pratiques, les-exposants, medias

acceptance_criteria: Screenshot the deployed home and each existing section landing vs the reference at 1440px and 375px. Fix component CSS/markup discrepancies (spacing, typography, colors, carousels, cards, grids, fonts) in the views until they match. Redeploy after fixes.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/content.sh projects/sial-paris sial-paris fr home
Gate 4-pre: present reference vs Jahia screenshots of home + section landings; return status halt for operator VALIDATED before any new pages are created.

epics.title: Capture + import page images
epics.goal: Capture each reference page's image URLs with a browser and import them into the DAM, so the content epic can reference real images. The headless agent cannot fetch images (the reference site blocks bots), so capture is a browser pre-step and import is deterministic.

review_criteria: A source image manifest exists for the project's pages
Images are imported into the DAM and the imported manifest records their jcrPaths

stories.title: Capture reference image URLs (browser)
stories.description: Extract content image URLs per page from the reference site into orchestration/images/<project>.json. MUST use a browser (Chrome MCP) - the site returns 403 to headless fetches. Filter to '/-/media/' content images, strip query strings.
acceptance_criteria: source image manifest exists and is non-empty

steps.title: Capture image URLs into the source manifest (BROWSER required)
acceptance_criteria: Image capture REQUIRES a browser (Chrome MCP); the reference site blocks headless fetch (403). For each page in orchestration/sitemaps/sial-paris.txt, extract content image URLs (filter '/-/media/', strip query strings) and write orchestration/images/sial-paris.json keyed by page path with {src, file, role: hero|section|person|logo}. If no browser is available to you, return status halt requesting the operator run the browser capture.

stories.title: Import images into the DAM
stories.description: Deterministically import every captured image via the sial-image-importer servlet and record the imported JCR node paths.
acceptance_criteria: imported manifest exists with jcrPaths; images served from the DAM

steps.title: Import images via the servlet (deterministic)
acceptance_criteria: Run the deterministic importer; it imports each image and writes orchestration/images/sial-paris.imported.json (page -> [{jcrPath, role}]).

epics.title: Content creation + review + accessibility
epics.goal: Create and publish all page content to LIVE, run code review and accessibility audit, and fix what they surface.

review_criteria: Every page's LIVE <main> text exceeds 400 chars in fr (and en where required)
axe-core reports 0 critical or serious violations on home + key pages

stories.title: Create + publish the full page tree
stories.description: Populate every page in orchestration/sitemaps/sial-paris.txt (31 pages, 3 levels) with content. The page TREE already exists (created in a prior run); 7 pages have content, 24 are empty shells. Be idempotent: for each path, if the page node is missing, create it; if it exists, REUSE it - do not recreate or duplicate. Then fill each empty page's main area with components that mirror the reference URL. Publish to live.
acceptance_criteria: every page in the sitemap has live content > 400 chars

steps.title: Create + publish all page content (Gate 4: HALT for visual fidelity)
acceptance_criteria: IDEMPOTENT: the page tree already exists. For each path in orchestration/sitemaps/sial-paris.txt, first check existence with MCP content.get (locale fr); if missing, page.create it; if present, REUSE the node (never recreate/duplicate). Then populate empty pages with content components mirroring the reference URL. The 24 sub-pages are currently empty shells. Use lowercase node names (Jahia lowercases them).

REUSE existing components - do NOT create new types per page (section 2b of AGENTS.md). Run `bash orchestration/probes/inventory.sh projects/sial-paris sialp` and map each section onto an existing sialp: type. If markup differs but properties match, add a view to the existing type. If a section genuinely fits no existing type, STOP and return status halt for an operator decision; do not invent a type.

Use the Jahia MCP server (JSON-RPC at $JAHIA_HOST/modules/mcp) for ALL node creation, property edits, and publishing. GraphQL is a fallback only when the MCP cannot perform an operation; if you fall back, state it in the summary.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/no-new-types.sh projects/sial-paris sialp orchestration/component-baseline.txt
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/content.sh projects/sial-paris sial-paris fr @orchestration/sitemaps/sial-paris.txt
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/no-url-images.sh projects/sial-paris sial-paris sialp
Gate 4: present reference vs Jahia screenshots at 1440px and 375px for a sample of new pages per section; return status halt for operator VALIDATED.

stories.title: Code review + accessibility
stories.description: Run the CTO-level code review and the axe-core accessibility audit; write reports.

steps.title: CTO-level code review (Gate 5: HALT for sign-off)
acceptance_criteria: Gate 5: present critical/warning/suggestion findings; return status halt for operator decisions on what to fix now.

epics.title: Visual diff + vanity URLs
epics.goal: Produce a section-by-section visual diff with zero critical gaps and a vanity-URL redirect map for go-live.

review_criteria: Old site URLs mapped to Jahia pages with an nginx redirect map

stories.title: Visual diff
stories.description: Screenshot every reference page vs the Jahia render and produce an ISO punch list.

stories.title: Vanity URLs
stories.description: Map old site URLs to Jahia pages and generate an nginx redirect map.
